title: Happy discovery…
text: This experience will enrich them historically, culturally, architecturally, spiritually, and much more… it is an excellent introduction to Andalusian culture; one cannot see everything at once… several visits are necessary for greater understanding… it is a wonderful opening that resonates seriously with current history....
author: Jacques_L

title: Great to recommend.
text:
Very satisfied.  Recommended.  The guide spoke excellent French and explained the evolution of the Alhambra very well.
The visit to the gardens was particularly interesting..
Everything went according to our wishes.
author: no_lb644
